capabilities.description: Exports completed Silo movie and episode watches to AniList anime lists.

global_config_schema.title: AniList OAuth application
global_config_schema.description: OAuth client settings used to connect Silo profiles to AniList. Register the callback URL shown by your Silo deployment in AniList.

presentation.summary: Scrobble completed Silo watch activity to AniList.
presentation.description_markdown: Exports completed anime movie watches to AniList as completed list entries and completed episode watches as series progress. AniList does not expose Silo-compatible history import, resume progress import, or live playback scrobbling, so this provider only advertises completed-watch export.
presentation.setup_markdown: Create an AniList OAuth application with the redirect URL https://YOUR-SILO-HOST/api/v1/watch-providers/anilist/auth/callback. Configure anilist.client_id plus the secret anilist.client_secret in the plugin's global settings. Silo connects each profile with AniList's authorization-code flow and stores returned access tokens as encrypted profile credentials.
